provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Hempfield (Westmoreland County), Chapter 87 Zoning, as published on eCode360, with Tables 1 to 4 as attachments
provenance.status_detail: eCode360: includes legislation through 03-23-2026 (Supp 74, Mar 2026). New Laws (2) listed, not opened. Table 1 and Table 3 amended 3-23-2026 by Ord. No. 2026-03. eCode360 is Cloudflare-walled for plain fetches. Text and table PDFs were read in a browser.
provenance.code_current_through_note: Includes legislation through 03-23-2026. New Laws (2) not yet codified.
checks: Outside the TND overlay the code has no ADU rule. A second unit may be sought as an unlisted use by special exception from the Zoning Hearing Board (87-15B, 87-186A). The Board must find its impact no greater than a listed use
The accessory apartment rule (87-79) is in Article XV, the TND overlay. The overlay covers six tax parcels (87-71, TND Exhibit A). Single-family dwellings are P in TC-R and N in TC-B (Table 1)

TC-R: one apartment within a single-family dwelling by special exception. One bedroom, more than 400 sq ft, at most 35% of the livable floor area. Owner lives in one unit. The other unit only for a relative by blood or marriage (87-79A)
No garage or portion of a garage may be used for or converted to a residential use (87-17G(1))
A nonpaying guest house in an accessory building is only for occasional guests, 'not for permanent occupancy by others as housekeeping units' (87-210 'Accessory building')
Nearest by-right alternative: a duplex is P in SR, CR and VR (Table 1). SR duplex lots need 8,000 sq ft per dwelling unit and 100 ft width (Table 3)

Table 2 lists 'Quarters separate from the principal dwelling (caretaker's quarters)' as P in A, RR, TC-R, NC and BT. No standards or definition. It is tied to a caretaker, not a general ADU path. Ask the Zoning Officer
TND parking: 2 spaces per dwelling unit, garages excluded (87-75, Table 5)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Planning and Zoning, https://www.hempfieldtwp.com/162/Planning-Zoning. Pending: New Laws (2) on eCode360 are Ord. 2026-05 (Development Authority) and 2026-06 (stray cats), per the review. Neither is about dwellings. A March 2026 news headline mentions proposed zoning changes. Not checked against an ordinance. Not law.

term.note: '§ 87-79. Accessory apartments.' The term sits only in Article XV, the TND overlay. 87-75 also says 'accessory dwelling units' for TND density counting.

status.note: Outside the TND overlay the code has no ADU text. Table 1 and Table 2 have no ADU row. The 87-79 accessory apartment rule reaches only the TND overlay (six tax parcels, TND Exhibit A), in practice TC-R.

path.note: 'Any use not listed in Table 1 ... or Table 2 ... may be authorized by special exception' if the Board finds its impact equal to or less than a listed use. Reading: a second unit is unlisted. The Board may also treat it as a duplex, which is listed.

fallback_path.note: If the Zoning Hearing Board does not accept the unlisted-use route, or a lot fails a rule, the path is a variance.

value.note: 'A special exception is required to create a single apartment within a single-family dwelling'. Family only, owner-occupied (87-79A(11), (12)).

district_paths.note: The accessory apartment rule applies in the TND overlay. Single-family dwellings are P in TC-R and N in TC-B (Table 1).

zoning_districts.note: The unlisted-use special exception is open in every district. The 87-79 rule is TC-R only.

building_types.note: No limit town-wide. In TC-R 87-79A needs 'a single-family dwelling' (detached or semidetached).

existing_structure_only.note: Text does not say whether the house must already exist.

value.condition: Accessory apartment in TC-R (87-79): one apartment inside a single-family dwelling, one bedroom, more than 400 sq ft, at most 35% of the livable floor area. Exterior stairs not on a street wall.
TC-R: the owner lives in one unit. The other unit 'may only be occupied by a person who is related by blood or marriage to such owner(s).'
TC-R: 87-79 needs a single-family dwelling. Townhouses and multifamily buildings do not qualify.
TC-R: the accessory apartment must be within the dwelling. No detached unit.
'No garage or portion of any garage shall be used for or converted to a residential use.'

An accessory building may hold a nonpaying guest house only 'for the occasional housing of guests' and 'not for permanent occupancy by others as housekeeping units'. Servants' quarters are listed. A detached rental unit is not.
TC-R: water and sewage must be certified adequate for two units, and the Municipal Authority must accept the added sewage demand.
Outside the TND, a special exception for an unlisted use needs a Board finding that its impact is equal to or less than a listed use (87-186A). Not an ADU rule. Nothing sets size or occupancy.

types_allowed.note: Unlisted-use route: no form is written. Garages may not hold a residence (87-17G(1)). In TC-R only inside the dwelling (gates).

max_sqft.note: No town-wide cap. TC-R: no square foot cap, only 35% (87-79A(4)).

max_share_of_house.note: No town-wide cap. TC-R: 'shall not exceed 35% of the entire livable gross floor area'. See gates.

min_sqft.note: No town-wide minimum. TC-R: 'greater than 400 square feet'.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory structures: building height 20 feet in A, RR, SR, CR and VR. ADU itself must be inside the house.

setback_front_ft.note: Accessory structures 'Shall not be constructed any closer to the front yard line than the front of the principal building'.

setback_side_ft.note: SR accessory structures: side yard 10 feet. A and RR 25 ft, CR and VR 5 ft. See districts.

setback_rear_ft.note: SR accessory structures: rear yard 10 feet. A and RR 35 ft, CR and VR 10 ft.

separation_ft.note: No separation between buildings on one lot found in 87-17.

internal_uses_district_height.note: Unit is inside the house, so the district height (35 ft) applies.

owner_occupancy.note: No town-wide rule. TC-R: 'The owner(s) ... must occupy one of the two residential units'. See gates.

family_only.note: No town-wide rule. TC-R: the non-owner unit only for a person 'related by blood or marriage'. See gates.

max_adus.note: No town-wide number. TC-R: 'Only one apartment is allowed'.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. TND Table 5: 'Single-family dwellings / 2 for each dwelling unit (garages excluded)'. Article XXI table outside the TND not read.

reading.value: TC-R: 2 spaces per dwelling unit, garages excluded. If the apartment counts as a unit, house and apartment need 4 off-garage spaces. If not, 2. Parking must be on the same parcel (87-79A(10)). Outside the TND the Article XXI table was not read.

new_connection_required.note: TC-R: water and sewage must be certified adequate for two units. Separate connections not addressed.

min_lot_sqft.note: SL1 and SL2 lots: 6K. SL3 and SL4 5K, LL1 and LL2 10K, EL1 and EL2 20K. Rear yard (home) 40 ft for SL1 and SL2.

setback_front_ft.note: 'Front yard (exc. porch)' 15 ft for SL1 to SL4.

setback_side_ft.note: 'Side yard, minimum' 5 ft, aggregate 15 ft for SL1 to SL4.

setback_rear_ft.note: 'Rear yard (home)' 40 ft for SL1 and SL2, 20 ft for SL3 and SL4. The apartment must be inside the house, so the home rear yard applies.

principal_max_height_ft.note: 'Maximum height (feet)' 38 for SL1 to SL4. 45 for larger lot types.

adu_path.note: 'A special exception is required to create a single apartment within a single-family dwelling'.

min_lot_sqft.note: SR single-family detached. Principal yards: front 30 ft, side 10 ft, rear 15 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. An accessory structure may not be closer to the front lot line than the front of the house (Table 4).

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, SR: side yard 10 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, SR: rear yard 10 feet.

min_lot_sqft.note: RR single-family detached with utilities. Principal yards: front 30 ft, side 25 ft, rear 35 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. An accessory structure may not be closer to the front lot line than the front of the house (Table 4).

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, RR: side yard 25 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, RR: rear yard 35 feet.

min_lot_sqft.note: A single-family detached with utilities. Principal yards: front 30 ft, side 25 ft, rear 35 ft.

setback_front_ft.note: District front yard. An accessory structure may not be closer to the front lot line than the front of the house (Table 4).

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, A: side yard 25 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, A: rear yard 35 feet.

min_lot_sqft.note: VR single-family detached. Front yard is the average of adjoining lots. Side 10 ft, rear 15 ft.

setback_side_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, CR and VR: side yard 5 feet. Principal side yard is in Table 3.

setback_rear_ft.note: Table 4 accessory structures, CR and VR: rear yard 10 feet.
